set.body: Repair remaining reproduced defects: phantom representation/space tags must be unforgeable through construction/copy; query native defaults agree; metadata always validates at construction; selection records parent and kept/dropped parcel derivation and has checked empty behavior. Reject duplicate/inconsistent detached ParcelValues immediately while preparing the field migration. Use existing CorticalHemisphere for single-side operations. Update affected compile-checked docs. Acceptance: the review probes become regression or compile-time rejection tests; JVM and JS pass; preserve exact assignment architecture.
set.title: Atlas: close constructor, query, metadata, and selection invariant gaps
